about: The puncture tutorial's runs. `runs`: each one `examples/puncture.py` through MIME's Experiment on a GitHub-hosted runner (float64), its settings, and the record of its RunResult (`result`, read by mime.results.RunResult.read: depth, force on the tip and crack area at every step, with units and flags). `engine_runs`: the 3-D engine's own runs outside MIME (engine.puncture3d.load_run; deletion and adaptive steps have no MIME build), each a pair of records. `sweeps`: the needle sweep, a Study run in memory (no study folder was written), its members' arrays kept here. `reference`: spike 3D-COST's rows for the 3-D blunt punch at h = 0.1 mm, the same solver run outside MIME.

sweep-gel-h0.1.runner_cpu: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor (and 3 other CPU models)
